context.body: The pit and the descent to Egypt · Genesis 37:23–30
context.label: The pit and the descent to Egypt

observations.body: The brothers strip Joseph, lower him into an empty pit, see a caravan, sell him, and leave Reuben facing the empty pit.
observations.label: The tunic is removed and Joseph is sold

observations.body: The passage presents Joseph is stripped, confined, lifted, and sold as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Joseph is stripped, confined, lifted, and sold

payload.posture: Read Genesis 37:23–30 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The caravan identities and sale action remain difficult to align
payload.title: The tunic is removed and Joseph is sold
